title: Abraham - the father of faith
introduction: Abraham is the father of faith and one of the Bible's most central figures. God called him out from Ur in Chaldea and promised that all families of the earth would be blessed through him. His life is an example of faith, obedience, and waiting on God's promises.

sections.title: The Call from God
sections.description: God called Abram to leave everything behind and follow Him to a unknown land.

sections.title: The Promise of a Son
sections.description: God promised Abraham a son, even though he and Sarah were old.

sections.title: The Test of Faith
sections.description: The greatest test - offering Isaac - and God's provision.

sections.title: Justified by Faith
sections.description: Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness.

sections.title: God's Friend
sections.description: Abraham was called God's friend because of his faith and obedience.
